provenance.method: Current mygov.scot and Social Security Scotland Adult Disability Payment information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records the Scotland route without making an individual entitlement claim.

name: Adult Disability Payment (Scotland)
description: The Social Security Scotland disability benefit route that has replaced Personal Independence Payment for people in Scotland.
intended_use: Check whether Adult Disability Payment is the relevant Scotland route and find current application information.
audience_or_context: People in Scotland considering disability support with extra costs arising from disability or a long-term health condition, subject to current eligibility rules.
limitations: This listing does not determine individual eligibility or award level.
Age, residence and other eligibility rules apply and can change.
People already receiving transferred benefits may follow different processes from new applicants.
cost_or_access_notes: Official information and applications are available through Social Security Scotland/mygov.scot, including phone and paper routes.
conflicts_of_interest: Social Security Scotland and mygov.scot are first-party public-service sources; ND Oracle records the route without assessing individual entitlement.
